title: The Complex Green's Function for Symmetric Sets
summary: The aim of this paper is threefold: (i) We study the complex Green's function (the analytic extension of the real Green's function) for multiply connected domains with some symmetry and transform it to a simple form with the help of Walsh's conformal map onto lemniscatic domains. (ii) For the complement of the union of two real intervals, we represent the complex Green's function with the help of Jacobi's elliptic and theta functions.
